record.field: SELECT DISTINCT a.aufnr, a.auart, d.matnr, pt.priokx, a.ktext, fe.fetxt, d.bdmng, f.bwart, t156.btext AS bwart_text, s2.srvpos, s2.ktext1 FROM aufk a LEFT JOIN afih b ON a.mandt=b.mandt AND a.aufnr=b.aufnr LEFT JOIN resb d ON a.mandt=d.mandt AND a.aufnr=d.aufnr LEFT JOIN makt e ON d.mandt=e.mandt AND e.matnr=d.matnr LEFT JOIN mseg f ON a.mandt=f.mandt AND a.aufnr=f.aufnr AND f.matnr=d.matnr LEFT JOIN qmel qm ON a.mandt=qm.mandt AND a.aufnr=qm.aufnr LEFT JOIN viqmfe fe ON qm.mandt=fe.mandt AND qm.qmnum=fe.qmnum LEFT JOIN t356_t pt ON pt.mandt=b.mandt AND pt.priok=b.priok AND pt.spras='E' AND pt.artpr='PM' LEFT JOIN afko k ON a.mandt = k.mandt AND a.aufnr = k.aufnr LEFT JOIN afvc v ON k.mandt = v.mandt AND k.aufpl = v.aufpl LEFT JOIN esll s1 ON v.mandt = s1.mandt AND v.packno = s1.packno LEFT JOIN esll s2 ON s1.mandt = s2.mandt AND s1.sub_packno = s2.packno LEFT JOIN t156t t156 ON f.mandt = t156.mandt AND f.bwart = t156.bwart AND f.sobkz = t156.sobkz AND t156.spras = 'E' WHERE (f.bwart IS NULL OR f.bwart IN ('Z61','Z62')) AND a.aufnr = '013211000019' AND (f.bwart IS NULL OR f.bwart='Z62' OR (f.bwart='Z61' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mseg x WHERE x.mandt=f.mandt AND x.aufnr=f.aufnr AND x.matnr=f.matnr AND x.bwart='Z62')))

SELECT DISTINCT a.aufnr, a.auart, b.equnr, il.tplnr, d.matnr, pt.priokx, a.ktext, fe.fetxt, d.bdmng, afk.gstrp, a.werks, f.bwart, t156.btext AS bwart_text, s2.srvpos, s2.ktext1 FROM aufk a LEFT JOIN afih b ON a.mandt = b.mandt AND a.aufnr = b.aufnr LEFT JOIN resb d ON a.mandt = d.mandt AND a.aufnr = d.aufnr LEFT JOIN makt e ON d.mandt = e.mandt AND e.matnr = d.matnr LEFT JOIN mseg f ON a.mandt = f.mandt AND a.aufnr = f.aufnr AND f.matnr = d.matnr LEFT JOIN qmel qm ON a.mandt = qm.mandt AND a.aufnr = qm.aufnr LEFT JOIN viqmfe fe ON qm.mandt = fe.mandt AND qm.qmnum = fe.qmnum LEFT JOIN t356_t pt ON pt.mandt = b.mandt AND pt.priok = b.priok AND pt.spras = 'E' AND pt.artpr = 'PM' LEFT JOIN iloa il ON il.iloan = b.iloan LEFT JOIN afko afk ON afk.aufnr = a.aufnr LEFT JOIN afvc v ON afk.mandt = v.mandt AND afk.aufpl = v.aufpl LEFT JOIN esll s1 ON v.mandt = s1.mandt AND v.packno = s1.packno LEFT JOIN esll s2 ON s1.mandt = s2.mandt AND s1.sub_packno = s2.packno LEFT JOIN t156t t156 ON f.mandt = t156.mandt AND f.bwart = t156.bwart AND f.sobkz = t156.sobkz AND t156.spras = 'E' WHERE a.auart in(’ZLF2’,ZLF3’,’ZLF4’,’ZLF5’,’ZLF6’,’ZLS2’,’ZLS3’,’ZLS4’,’ZLS5’,’ZLS6’) AND (f.bwart IS NULL OR f.bwart IN ('Z61','Z62')) AND (f.bwart IS NULL OR f.bwart='Z62' OR (f.bwart='Z61' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mseg x WHERE x.mandt=f.mandt AND x.aufnr=f.aufnr AND x.matnr=f.matnr AND x.bwart='Z62')))
select a.grund, a.grdtx, a.werks from trugt a where a.werks in('1321','1443') and a.spras = 'EN'
